workflow.name: Idea to 3D Asset Pipeline
workflow.description: Turns a natural-language idea into a rendered 3D asset in a mobile app: OpenRouter free-model prompt refinement → Gemini image gen → remove.bg crop/isolate → Meshy image-to-3D → GitHub commit of .glb + generated RN/R3F viewer component.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: "meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct:free", messages: [ { role: "system", content: "You are an expert prompt engineer for text-to-image models. Turn the user idea into a single, highly detailed image generation prompt describing ONE isolated 3D-game-ready asset, centered, on a plain solid white or transparent background, studio lighting, front-facing orthographic-friendly view, no shadows on ground, no extra objects, no text or watermarks, high detail suitable for photogrammetry/image-to-3D conversion. Respond with ONLY the final prompt text, nothing else." }, { role: "user", content: $json.body.idea } ], temperature: 0.7 }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ contents: [ { parts: [ { text: $json.refinedPrompt } ] } ], generationConfig: { responseModalities: ["IMAGE"] } }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ image_url: $json.imageDataUri, enable_pbr: true, should_remesh: true, ai_model: "meshy-5" }) }}

parameters.commitMessage: ={{ "feat(ui): add generated 3D viewer component for \"" + $("Generate RN Viewer Component").item.json.originalIdea + "\"" }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: "ready", requestId: $("Generate RN Viewer Component").item.json.requestId, modelPath: $("Generate RN Viewer Component").item.json.modelPath, componentPath: $("Generate RN Viewer Component").item.json.componentPath, refinedPrompt: $("Generate RN Viewer Component").item.json.refinedPrompt }) }}

assignments.name: message
assignments.value: ={{ "Mesh generation status: " + $json.status + ". Increase Wait duration or add a polling loop for production use." }}

parameters.content:
## Stage 1: Prompt Refiner Agent
FREE OpenRouter model expands the idea into an image-gen prompt: isolated subject, plain background, studio lighting.

## Stage 2: Image Generation (Gemini)
Calls Gemini image generation and decodes base64 into n8n binary data.

## Stage 3: Crop & Isolate
remove.bg strips background AND auto-crops to the subject bounding box (crop=true) in one call.

## Stage 4: Image-to-3D
Meshy's documented REST API (async job + poll). image-to-3d.ai has no public API — see chat response for a browser-automation alternative.

## Stage 5: IDE Orchestrator
Generates a React Native / react-three-fiber viewer component and commits both the .glb and the component straight into the mobile app repo via the GitHub API.
